instructions: The night before, or at least 1 hour ahead: cook the bacon in a skillet over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, until crisp. Transfer to a paper-towel-lined plate to cool.
Cut the broccoli into small bite-size florets, then wash them and dry them very well. That should be about 4 cups.
Finely dice 3 tbsp of the red onion. Crumble the cooled bacon.
In a large bowl, whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper until the sugar dissolves.
Add the broccoli, onion, bacon, cranberries and sunflower seeds to the bowl and stir until everything is coated.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. It keeps in the fridge for 4 to 5 days.
advance_prep_notes: make it at least 1 hour ahead, ideally the night before
method_notes: Spend With Pennies (4.99 from 1,405 ratings) tosses raw broccoli florets, red onion, dried cranberries, sunflower seeds and bacon in a mayo, cider vinegar and sugar dressing and chills it for an hour. This version is halved to serve 4 and uses real bacon, cooked and crumbled. Other versions (Cookie Rookie, Sugar Spun Run) add cheddar or sour cream, which are left out to stay dairy-free. Dairy-free and gluten-free depend on checking the mayonnaise and cranberry labels.
